rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments from Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation of core inflation to 3.60%, I must emphasize that headline CPI at 5.10% remains significantly above our 4.00% target. The persistent food inflation at 8.30% is a critical concern that directly impacts household inflation expectations. A shift to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature and could be misconstrued as a premature easing of our resolve to bring inflation durably to the target. Given the positive output gap of 0.50% and the prevailing liquidity conditions, maintaining the withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that the disinflationary process remains on track without compromising our growth momentum.
